method.labels: Known synthetic construction, not human visibility/quality labels. Natural source is unlabelled.
method.threshold: 10 is an illustrative fixed coarse-step screening policy, not a calibrated recommendation or product default.
method.runtime: Independent cold HTTP jobs with committed media; OS caches may remain warm. No time/throughput assertion.
method.processRss: 10ms samples of this whole Node service/test process including Workers, not an isolated task or OS quota.
method.http: Sequential read-only library probes, bounded128 samples, no flood or percentile gate.
limitations: Small structured fixture set, not a population accuracy estimate.
Natural footage is one processed repeated frame.
No subjective pass/fail, temporal tracking, HDR or arbitrary-content certification.
Content-changing texture and noise are covered; camera motion, cuts and flicker need separate labelled temporal data.
